prefix_note: Composer name is `local/flarum-analytics`. Flarum\Extension\Extension::nameToId (framework/core/src/Extension/Extension.php:126-132) does str_replace(['flarum-ext-', 'flarum-'], '', $package) on the package half, so the id is `local-analytics`, NOT `local-flarum-analytics`. No keys are written here, but the prefix is recorded because getting it wrong is a silent miss.

deferred.reason: Not user-visible, and the audit's only finding for this extension. It is the `error` member of the array sendBatch() returns; the single caller is Console/FlushCommand.php, which prints it to the terminal. No HTTP response, no view, no notification carries it. Translating it would make the operator's console output depend on the forum's locale.
Same slot as above — a diagnostic for the operator, carrying an upstream HTTP status and 200 bytes of PostHog's own (English) response body. It must stay verbatim to be useful.

deferred.reason: The allow-list of event TYPE names. These are wire identifiers written to analytics_events.type and forwarded to PostHog as the event name; RecomputeRankCommand matches on them in SQL (lines 51-56). Translating any of them would silently break ranking and split every PostHog funnel in two.
JSON:API attribute names, consumed by the frontend as data, not shown as text.

finding: flarum-analytics has NO user-visible strings. Every quoted literal in src/ and js/ is an event-type identifier, a database column, a JSON:API attribute name, SQL, or console output. It renders nothing: js/src/forum/index.js contains no text either (it is pure instrumentation), and extend.php only attaches it when js/dist/forum.js exists, which it does not on disk. No locale/en.yml or locale/es.yml is written, and no Extend\Locales line is added, because an empty locale pack is a maintenance liability rather than coverage. The audit reported 92.9% coverage / 13 'translated' strings for this extension; those 13 are dotted identifiers (event type names like `discussion.dwell`) that its KEY_RE happens to match, not translations.

out_of_scope_defects.problem: `Api\IngestController::class` and `Api\FeedController::class` are written relative, but the file has no `use Local\Analytics\Api;` (only Models, Listeners and the two Console classes are imported). In the global namespace of extend.php these resolve to `\Api\IngestController` and `\Api\FeedController`.
out_of_scope_defects.impact: Extend\Routes resolves the handler lazily, so this is a 500 on POST /api/analytics/events rather than a boot error — the client instrumentation endpoint is dead.
out_of_scope_defects.fix: Add `use Local\Analytics\Api;` beside the existing `use Local\Analytics\Listeners;` on line 27.

out_of_scope_defects.problem: `Local\Analytics\Api\FeedController` does not exist. src/Api/ contains only IngestController.php.
out_of_scope_defects.fix: Write the class or drop the route.

out_of_scope_defects.problem: `Listeners\CaptureModeration::class` does not exist. src/Listeners/ has no CaptureModeration.php.
out_of_scope_defects.impact: This one IS a boot-path failure. Extend\Event->listen() registers the listener at extender-application time and the container resolves the class when Flarum\Post\Event\Hidden or Flarum\Discussion\Event\Renamed fires — a hide or a rename throws instead of completing. Two of the eight listeners on that extender point at it.
out_of_scope_defects.fix: Write Local\Analytics\Listeners\CaptureModeration (the other seven Capture* classes are three lines each and are the template), or remove the two ->listen() calls.
